summary: The PR correctly implements the required HTML escaping and attribute filtering logic, passing all unit tests and preserving legacy behavior.
key_findings: escape_html_text uses html.escape with quote=True, correctly handling &, <, >, ", and '.
filter_attrs correctly rejects keys starting with 'on' and values starting with 'javascript:', while HTML-escaping remaining values.
Legacy wrap_tag function remains unchanged and its test passes.
